Okay, Renato, a quick update before your quarterfinal. The conditions this afternoon are unpredictable. The tide is higher now, so the peak might move closer to the beach. The wind is changing too. There may be some strong gusts from the south, and they might make the waves choppy. Your opponents are Finn Carter, Ethan Moss and Noah Brooks. Finn is a local, and he won this contest last year, so everybody thinks you're the underdog. That's fine. No pressure. There might be a long lull in the middle of the heat, so don't panic if the ocean goes flat. And if you're not in the lead after ten minutes, there's still time for a comeback. I'm not certain about the scores today, but two good sixes may be enough. Okay? Breathe. You're ready.

Jess, it's Kai. You're missing it! Renato's quarterfinal started ten minutes ago, and it's crazy. Finn got a seven on his first wave, so he's in the lead. Then there was a long lull, nothing for five minutes. Renato just sat there on his board, really calm. And then a big set came, and he didn't hesitate. He got a great wave, maybe a seven too. Now he might be in second place, but I'm not certain. Ethan Moss is really close. There are four minutes left, and the wind is changing again, so the last waves might be messy. He may need one more good wave. Honestly, anything might happen. The scores might be on the board in a minute. I'll call you after the horn. Okay, bye!
